reasons.usability: Dynamic HOLD ROUTE / APPROACH / FACE COILS, map markers, auto reload, numbered coil progress and fresh restart reduce getting lost. Threat messages behind the assisted view compete with mission guidance.
reasons.readability: Health, ammo, objective, coil percentages, and upload percentage are legible at 844x390. Smaller environmental signs and explanatory copy are harder to read; overlays occupy appreciable landscape space.
